tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 50 (context-date anaphora + exclusive anchor route enum). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys. CONTEXT - two live findings: (A) extraction sometimes emits raw anaphoric text like 'Monday that week' as the from field; the gateway cannot resolve it (no referent) and falls to the default window, producing wrong-week results; the pathway HOLDS the referent (the offered date) and will now send it. (B) an adversarial audit proved the anchor search's response conditions (ok != true / slot_count == 0 / anchor_exact == true / anchor_exact != true) are simple but NOT mutually exclusive - an error or zero-slot payload can also match an anchor_exact row; the fix is a server-side single route enum. BASE FILE: ./deployed-bland_gateway.py is byte-equal to production image mott-lane-49. Minimal in-style diff. THE FIX: (1) CONTEXT_DATE: accept an OPTIONAL request field 'context_date' on /availability (a date or datetime string; parse tolerantly incl. trailing clock). When present AND the from/to text contains an anaphoric week/day reference with a weekday - forms like '<weekday> that week', '<weekday> the same week', '<weekday> of that week', or raw '<weekday> that week' - resolve from/to to that weekday within context_date's Monday-anchored week. When from is anaphoric WITHOUT a weekday ('that week') resolve to context_date's week (Monday through Friday window). Absent context_date or non-anaphoric from-text: behavior unchanged. context_date must never override a from that already resolves on its own. (2) ANCHOR_ROUTE ENUM: for requests whose time_pref is an anchor form, add result field 'anchor_route' with EXACTLY ONE of: 'error' (request failed / ok false), 'none' (no slots in window), 'exact' (first slot equals the requested clock), 'closest' (slots exist, first is not the exact clock). Compute it server-side so exactly one value is always present; keep anchor_exact for compatibility. Non-anchor requests omit anchor_route. (3) Tests (frozen-today, handler seam): from='Monday that week' + context_date='08/18/2026 10:30 am' -> 08/17; from='that week' + context_date 08/18 -> Monday-anchored window of that week; from='monday the week of 08/18/2026' ignores context_date (self-resolving); anchor cases yield each enum value exactly once across error/none/exact/closest payloads; full suite green in ./gwtest (copy of /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW44b/gw-week-vocab-live-fix/gwtest with the fixed file; count >= 85). (4) ./proof_context.py standalone offline prints: 'CASE=anaphora-context FROM=2026-08-17', 'CASE=bare-that-week FROM=2026-08-17 TO=2026-08-21', 'CASE=route-exact ROUTE=exact', 'CASE=route-closest ROUTE=closest', 'CASE=route-none ROUTE=none', 'CASE=route-error ROUTE=error'. (5) DEBUG-GW50.md: the evidence, the two contracts, code locations, output tails, deploy separately gated.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_context.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -5 proof.out; exit 1; }; for c in 'CASE=anaphora-context FROM=2026-08-17' 'CASE=bare-that-week FROM=2026-08-17 TO=2026-08-21' 'CASE=route-exact ROUTE=exact' 'CASE=route-closest ROUTE=closest' 'CASE=route-none ROUTE=none' 'CASE=route-error ROUTE=error'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 85 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests"; exit 1; }; grep -qi 'anchor_route' DEBUG-GW50.md || { echo 'FAIL: DEBUG lacks the enum contract'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: context-date + route enum proven - $summary"
tasks.verified: Anaphoric week references resolve deterministically against the pathway-supplied context date, and anchor searches return exactly one mutually exclusive route value - killing both the extraction-nondeterminism class and the non-exclusive-condition class at the gateway layer.
